chapter.verse: Sanggamte aw, note' tunga kong tangko, note in zong sangin na dinpih uh ahi Lungdamna Thu, tu-in kong phawngkik nuam hi.
Tua kong tangko uh lungdamna thu na letkip uhleh—a mawk up pong na hihkei nak uhleh—tua thu tawh hotkhiat a ngah na hi uh hi.
A hang pen ke'n zong sangin note' tungah a masapenin kong hopsawn thu in: Pasian' Laibupi ii genna bangin Khris pen eite' mawhna hangin si hi;
amah kivui-in Pasian' Laibupi' genna bangin a ni thumni-in thokik hi;
Cephas' tungah kilang a, tua ciangin sawmlenihte' tungah kilang hi.
A zom ah hun khat sungin sanggamte za-nga val tungah kilang a, tua mite a ihmu khin kimkhat a om hangin a tamzaw nungta lai uh hi.
Tua ciangin James' tung leh sawltakpite khempeuh' tungah kilang hi.
A nunungpen ah hunlo phatlo khat-a suak bang ahi kei' tungah zong hong kilang hi.
Banghanghiam cihleh kei pen sawltakpite lakah a neupen ka hi a, Pasian' pawlpi bawlsia ka hih manin sawltakpi cih dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi.

Himah taleh Pasian' hehpihna tawh kei pen ka hi bang ahi ka hi a, kei' tunga hong hehpihna zong a hawmpi hilo hi. Hilo kisa-in amaute sangin zong ka hahkatzaw a, tua pen kei hilo-in kei hong ompih Pasian' hehpihna ahi hi.
Tua hi a, kei ka hi-a amaute ahi zongin kote in tu-a bangin thu kong tangko uh a, note in zong tu-a bangin a um na hi uh hi.
Tu-in Khris pen misite' lakpan thokik ci-in kitangko ahihleh bang hangin note kimkhat in misite' thawhkikna om lo ci thei na hi uh hiam?
Misite' thawhkikna om lo hileh Khris nangawn a thokik lo hiding hi.
Khris thokik lo ahihleh ka thutangko uh a mawkna suak ding a, na upna uh zong a mawkna hiding hi.
Misite thokik lo ding cih thu a maan ahih mawk leh kote zong Pasian' thawhkiksak loh Khris pen Pasian in thokiksak ci-in teci pang ka hih manun Pasian' thu a maanlo pi-in a gen ka hiding uh hi.
A hang pen misite thokik lo ding ahihleh Khris nangawn a thokik lo hiding hi.
Khris thokik lo ahihleh na upna uh zong a taanglamlo suak ding a, na mawhna teng mah uh tawh a omlai na hiding uh hi.
Tua banah Khris sunga a ihmu khinte zong a kisia khin hiding hi.
Khris hanga i neih lametna pen hih leitung nuntakna sung bek' ading ahihleh mi citeng lakah a khasiat-huaipen i hiding hi.
Ahih hangin Khris pen misite' lakpan thokik takpi a, a ihmu khinte lakah a palpen suak hi.
A hang pen mi khat hangin sihna hong tung ahih mah bangin mi khat hangin misite' thawhkikna hong tung hi.
A hang pen Adam tungtawnin mi khempeuh si ahih mah bangin Khris tungtawnin mi khempeuh a nungta kisuaksak ding hi.
Ahi zongin khat ciat amau' hun tek tawh hiding hi: Khris a palpen hiding a, a zom ah ama' hong pai hun ciangin Khris mite hiding hi.
Tua khit ciangin kicinna hiding a, Khris in gam-uk khempeuh, uktheihna thu khempeuh leh vangliatna khempeuh a beisak khit ciangin Pa Pasian' kiangah kumpigam ap ding hi.
A hang pen Khris in Pasian' khe nuai-ah a galte a vekin a koih khit mateng kumpi sem ding hi.
Suksiat ding gal a nunungpen ahihleh sihna ahi hi.
A hang pen “amah in na khempeuh ama' khe nuai-ah niamlutsak hi.” Ahi zongin, “na khempeuh niamlutsak,” a cih ciangin Khris' nuai-ah na khempeuh a niamlutsak ahi Pasian kihel lo cih teltak kilang hi.

Na khempeuh ama' kiangah a kiniamlutsak hun ciangin Tapa mahmah zong ama' nuai-ah na khempeuh a niamlutsak ahi Pasian' kiangah niamlut ding a, tua pen Pasian mah na khempeuh a huamkim ahih nading ahi hi.
Tua hilo hileh misite' taangin baptize a la mite bang a deihna uh ahi hiam? Misite thokik vet lo ding ahihleh bang hangin mite amau' taangin kibaptize uh ahi hiam?
Bang hangin kote in hunlenai citengin lauhuaina tuak ka hi uh hiam?
Sanggamte aw, note kong kisialhpih zah mahin i Topa Khris Jesu' sungah ka kisialhpih thu pen: hunleni citengin sihna ka tuakkha hi.
Ephesus khua ah gamsate tawh ka kilai pen mihing' muhna pan bang lawhtaak ka hi hiam? Misite thokik lo ahihleh, “Zingciang si ding i hih manin anne tuidawnin om ni.”
Theikhialkha kei un: “Kikholhpih hoih lo in gamtatzia a hoihte siasak hi.”
Thu tangtakin phawk unla mawhna bawl nawnkei un. A hang pen mi kimkhat Pasian kitheihmawhbawl uh hi. Na zum nadingun hih bang hong gen ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin mi khatpeuh in, “Misite bangci thawhkik ding uh ahi hiam? Bangci nam pumpi tawh hong pai ding uh ahi hiam?” ci ding hi.
Lungmawl mi aw, na tuh khaici a muat masiah hing theilo ding hi.
Mangbuh ahi-a khaici dang khatpeuh ahi zongin tua na tuh uh pen a khaici tang lian bek mah hi a, a kungpi hong pokhia ding pen hilo hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in a sawmsa om bangin tua khaici' tungah kungpi khat guan a, khaici nam khat tek' tungah zong amau' kungpi ding khatta guan hi.
A hang pen cilesa khempeuh a kibang khin hilo a, mihingte nam khat, gante a tuam khat, vasate a tuam khat, ngasate a tuam khat, ahi hi.
Vantung pumpi omin leitung pumpi zong om a, ahi zongin vantung nate a minphatna uh nam khat, leitung nate a minphatna uh a tuam khat, ahi hi.
Ni a minphatna nam khat, kha a minphatna a tuam khat, aksite a minphatna uh a tuam khat hi a, aksite zong khatlekhat a minphatna uh a tuam tek ahi hi.
Misite' thawhkikna zong tua bang mah ahi hi. A kituh pen a muatthei hi a, a pokhia pen a muattheilo ahi hi.
Zumhuaina tawh kituh a, minphatna tawh pokhia hi. Thanemna tawh kituh a, thahatna tawh pokhia hi.
A kituh lai-in leitung pumpi hi a, a thawhkik ciangin kha pumpi ahi hi. Leitung pumpi om ahihleh kha pumpi zong om hi.
Tua hangin, “Mihing masabel Adam pen nuntakna nei khat suak hi,” ci-in kigelh a, a nunungbel Adam ahihleh a nungtasak Kha suak hi.
Ahih hangin a om masa pen kha pumpi hilo-in leitung pumpi hizaw a, a zom ah kha pumpi om hi.
Mi a khatna pen lei pana piang, leivui tawh kibawl hi a, mi a nihna pen vantung pana piang ahi hi.
Leivui pana piangte pen leivui pana piang mipa mah bang uh a, vantung pana piangte zong vantung pana piang mipa mah bang uh hi.
Eite zong lei pana piang mipa' limlemel i puak bangin vantung pana piang mipa' limlemel i pua ding hi.
Sanggamte aw, tu-in kong cihin ah si leh sa in Pasian' kumpigam luah theilo ding a, a muattheite in a muattheilo luah theilo ding hi.
En un, thusim khat kong gen ding hi. I vekpi-in a ihmu ding i hikei a, i vekpi-in a kikhel ding i hi hi.
Tua pen thakhat thu, mitphiat kal sung, pengkul nunungbel a kimut hun hiding hi. A hang pen pengkul hong gin ciangin misite a siatheilo namin hong thokik ding uh a, tua ciangin eite i kikhel ding hi.
A hang pen hih a siathei pen in siattheihlohna silh ding a, hih a sithei pen in sihtheihlohna silh ding hi.
A siathei pen in siattheihlohna silhin a sithei pen in sihtheihlohna a silh ciangin a nuai-a a kigelh thu a tangtung ding ahi hi: “Sihna pen galzawhna sungah tumcip hi.”
“Sihna aw, na galzawhna koi ah om ahi hiam? Sihna aw, na gu koi ah om ahi hiam?”
Sihna ii gu pen mawhna hi a, mawhna ii tha pen thukhun ahi hi.
Himah taleh i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin galzawhna hong pia Pasian' tungah i lungdam hi.
Tua ahih manin kong it sanggamte aw, lungkip unla linglawng kei un. Na nasepte uh Topa' sungah mawkna ngeilo cih thei kawmin Topa' na sepna ah nakpi hahkat un.
